implementationMessage: The replacement YOUTUBE_API_KEY has been configured as a ChatGPT Sites secret, but the deployed OshiLive 3.0 page still shows 'Live status is waiting for connection', 'Schedule is waiting for connection', and API-waiting states on liver cards. This confirms the production Site is not yet consuming the YouTube API successfully. The current Sites build appears to remain in placeholder/fallback mode, so adding the secret alone is insufficient; the live Sites source must actually wire server-side YouTube API handlers to YOUTUBE_API_KEY and then be redeployed.
safetyMessage: REVIEW: credential exposure is remediated, but the actual deployed OshiLive 3.0 runtime is not connected to YouTube yet. Do not mark SAFE until the ChatGPT Sites implementation is updated/redeployed and live-status, upcoming-streams, and channel-by-url are demonstrated working on the production Site without exposing the secret.
